verdict.rationale: Community reports say Fastmail offers a new EU (Amsterdam) data region alongside its default hosting, so users can choose a storage region. Per the same reports, Fastmail says it cannot guarantee data stays only in the EU, which weakens the residency guarantee. Evidence for the region option is community-only, with no first-party documentation in the pack. Missing for 10: first-party docs on how to select a region, the list of available regions, a contractual residency guarantee that data stays in-region, and independent hands-on verification.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: A European customer appreciates the EU data region.
they state they can't guarantee data remains only in the EU
